entries.title: Reading an email's attachment starts a task that can open it
entries.body: When you ask your first mate to read files attached to an email, it now starts a task that can open them, instead of one that reads only the email's text. If such a task still meets an attachment, it says the file needs another task, not that a setting is off.
entries.noPicture: This changes which task the first mate starts and what a crewmate says, not how any view looks.
